items.title: Kenny Davern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Today you get all twenty trumpet players that try to sound like Clifford Brown and they do. And it’s difficult to know one from the other you see.

ctx.x: Well listen, as long as we’re on a few people I wanted to ask your maybe just reactions to a couple of names I’ll give to you. We already touched on Pee Wee Russell. Touch some more on Pee Wee Russell. What was it about him that was unique? Or maybe he wasn’t.

He was very unique. Any time you want to hear somebody try to sound like him it’s laughable because you know who they’re doing. You know instantly they’re trying to mock — or not really mock but — if you’re trying to do Pee Wee, and I know somebody here who does him very well, but at the same time I can’t take his playing seriously enough because he’s doing Pee Wee. And only Pee Wee could do Pee Wee. You know a lot of guys try to do Louis Armstrong and they ended up really becoming themselves, whether it’s Louis…
